ns2:section.sectionText: In this course you will become proficient in Inform 7, a programming language for interactive fiction (IF). During the semester you'll translate a work of non-English literature into an interactive format, either a "text-adventure" game, or a more literary work of IF. You will also collaborate on a team-written historical simulation. Students will need to bring a laptop to class. No prior programming experience required. For more information, contact Judith Pintar, jpintar@illinois.edu.
